/--
Type class for the `insert` operation.
Used to implement the `{ a, b, c }` syntax.
-/
class Insert (α : outParam <| Type u) (γ : Type v) where
  /-- `insert x xs` inserts the element `x` into the collection `xs`. -/
  insert : α → γ → γ
